name: arrival_measures_v1
status: FROZEN 2026-10-09 after red-team revision 2 (FREEZE-WITH-AMENDMENTS, amendments A1-A6 applied); changes require a new version
authoritative_implementation: src/navfm/collection/episode_measures.py (episode_measures, turn_tracking, admitted_rate); scripts/audit_closed_loop_episodes.py calls it; collector `metrics` blocks are NOT authoritative
unit: episode = one policy run of one route; development reports counts and paired per-route tables only (no intervals); held-out reports route counts with scene-cluster summaries because the two routes of a scene share it

conventions.scoring_goal: the goal image's capture position. The audit refuses policy episodes without --goal-root, and refuses a goal root whose declared source frame or goal bytes differ from those the episode recorded. Distance to the route endpoint is reported as closest_endpoint_m / min_endpoint_distance_m
conventions.stop: the latched policy decision frame (policy_stop_frame). The collector keeps simulating until stop+24 frames and at least frame 107, or until max_steps. A stop within 1 s of max_steps leaves settling UNMEASURABLE and is scored as a wrong stop: a known bias against late stops
conventions.contact_frame: first capture frame with simulation_time >= first contact report time (searchsorted, left)
conventions.counted_contacts: any contact report pairing a robot prim with a /World/Fixture prim other than */Floor (collector contact filter; threshold 0)
conventions.timeout: no stop decision within max_steps; the budget is recorded per run (manifest max_steps, from this revision) and reported as max_steps_budget beside frames_recorded
conventions.yaw_rate_setpoint: the yaw rate the base controller is asked to realise: the policy output before any open-loop wheel gain; with --yaw-feedback no gain is applied; without it the wheel map multiplies by 0.8 when moving and 1.5 when turning in place, and that actuator signal is reported separately when relevant
conventions.termination_label: collector termination is policy_stop whenever a stop decision exists (from this revision; earlier runs may say timeout for a stop in the final 24 frames, and the measures' timeout field governs)

admitted_trajectory_rate.definition: admitted / planned. planned = the collection's frozen routes (one run each; for sealed held-out runs, the ledger entry's routes). Each planned route is classified exactly once from artefacts as never_run, failed, refused, rejected or admitted (episode_measures.admitted_rate reading frozen_routes.json, collection.json and the admission report); no hand-entered counts

controller_tracking.qualification: per session, a fixed free-space command replay and turn sweep (qualify_articulated_control.py): realised-on-setpoint slope in [0.8, 1.2], sign agreement >= 0.9, per-case |error| <= max(0.03, 0.25|w|)
controller_tracking.in_episode_diagnostic: slope over held setpoints with |w| >= 0.1 rad/s before first contact or stop; fewer than 20 such commands is INSUFFICIENT; otherwise WITHIN_BAND or OUTSIDE_BAND of [0.8, 1.2]; a diagnostic only, never a qualification

navigation_success.definition: the robot enters the goal region (scoring-goal distance <= arrival radius) at a frame before the first counted contact; time spent in the region is reported
navigation_success.caveat: counts pass-throughs. It may be reported for an arm only together with the measured goal-blind control row for the same routes; without that row the quantity is labelled goal-region visit
navigation_success.time_in_goal_region: frames inside the region up to the task end and before first contact, times the median frame interval

correct_stop.definition: stop decision at scoring-goal distance <= radius AND settle == SETTLED (motion < 0.01 m over the final 1 s, which must lie after the stop) AND final scoring-goal distance <= radius
correct_stop.settle_states: NO_STOP, SETTLED, MOVING, UNMEASURABLE (less than 1 s of frames after the stop); UNMEASURABLE is never correct
correct_stop.wrong_stop: any stop decision that is not a correct stop
correct_stop.settle_window: the final 1 s of the recording, which must lie wholly after the stop; motion is measured from the first frame of that window; displacement from the stop pose over all later frames is reported as displacement_after_stop_m

collision_episode.primary: a counted contact at or before the task end (stop frame, or the last frame if no stop)
collision_episode.secondary: contact after the stop, reported separately
collision_episode.exposure: elapsed time to task end, total simulated time and path length are reported because non-stopping runs are exposed longer

completion.definition: correct stop and no collision before task end; reported beside navigation success and correct stop, never in place of them

also_reported: route departure frame and maximum lateral deviation
minimum and final distance to scoring goal and to route endpoint

reporting: explicit denominators per arm including episodes that failed or were refused; paired per-route tables between arms; no significance claims; development: counts only
superseded_definitions: collector runtime_manifest `metrics` blocks (success against the route endpoint) and src/navfm/collection/feasibility_metrics.py are not evaluation measures under this definition; they remain for historical feasibility reports only
